recordedProductIssues: Redaction chips are tiny gold padlocks on dark bars; cursor wanders over the form.

defects.problem: Screenshot occupies only about 2/3 of width at roughly 400 px at feed size; field labels and the masks are unreadable, so the privacy proof is carried only by the checklist.
defects.fix: Scale the screenshot up and stack the checklist beside or below it, tying each item to a mask.

defects.problem: Switch to 'The exact upload' view changes layout (checklist removed, text moves right) with large empty right and bottom areas.
defects.fix: Keep the same layout and swap only the image.

defects.problem: Four checklist items stay yellow while 'Name' is empty for long and the yellow marker under the title shifts length; reads busy for a static scene.

oneLineVerdict: Good story, but the evidence image is small and the final layout shifts.
